PROVISIONAL INTERNATIONAL RATES

Transparent Investment.
Zero Hidden Overhead.

We operate with complete commercial clarity. Review our proposed starting rates across all four divisions below, protected by our standard 50% milestone delivery escrow model.

🔒 50% Milestone Protection

Standard development sprints require a 50% advance deposit to initiate. The final 50% balance is payable strictly after staging verification and your written signoff.

💎 Zero Hidden Fees Guarantee

Zero undisclosed agency surcharges, no repository export fees, and no surprise lock-in costs. All projects include 100% source code ownership and a 30-day bug-fix warranty.

🌐 Global Invoicing & Currencies

Prices are quoted in USD ($). We accept international wire, corporate cards, and compliant digital invoices for clients across the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and Europe.

📦 Transparent Pass-Through

External ad spend, third-party LLM API tokens (OpenAI/Claude), domains, and client cloud hosting are billed directly by third parties at raw cost with zero agency markup.
